Load libraries required for data visualisation and analysis

```{r}
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
```

```{r}

influence_edges <- c(
  "InStyleOf",
  "InterpolatesFrom",
  "DirectlySamples",
  "CoverOf",
  "LyricalReferenceTo"
)

get_oceanus_ids <- function(nodes) {
  nodes %>% filter(genre == "Oceanus Folk") %>% pull(id)
}

```

```{r}

inspect_raw_data <- function(file_path) {

  data <- fromJSON(file_path)
  nodes <- data$nodes
  links <- data$links

  colnames(nodes) <- colnames(nodes) %>% str_replace_all(" ", "_")
  colnames(links) <- colnames(links) %>% str_replace_all(" ", "_")

  valid_ids <- nodes$id[!is.na(nodes$id)]

  missing_node_ids <- nodes %>% filter(is.na(id))
  duplicate_node_ids <- nodes %>% filter(duplicated(id) | duplicated(id, fromLast = TRUE))
  missing_names <- nodes %>% filter(is.na(name))
  missing_genres <- nodes %>% filter(Node_Type %in% c("Song", "Album") & is.na(genre))

  missing_link_endpoints <- links %>% filter(is.na(source) | is.na(target))

  duplicate_links <- links %>%
    filter(
      duplicated(select(., source, target, Edge_Type)) |
      duplicated(select(., source, target, Edge_Type), fromLast = TRUE)
    )

  self_loops <- links %>% filter(source == target)
  invalid_links <- links %>% filter(!(source %in% valid_ids) | !(target %in% valid_ids))
  orphan_nodes <- nodes %>% filter(!(id %in% unique(c(links$source, links$target))))

  date_nodes <- nodes
  for (col in c("release_date", "written_date", "notoriety_date")) {
    if (col %in% colnames(date_nodes))
      date_nodes[[col]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(date_nodes[[col]]))
  }

  release_before_written <- if (all(c("release_date", "written_date") %in% colnames(date_nodes))) {
    date_nodes %>% filter(!is.na(release_date) & !is.na(written_date) & release_date < written_date)
  } else data.frame()

  notoriety_before_release <- if (all(c("notoriety_date", "release_date") %in% colnames(date_nodes))) {
    date_nodes %>% filter(!is.na(notoriety_date) & !is.na(release_date) & notoriety_date < release_date)
  } else data.frame()

  problem_counts <- data.frame(
    problem = c(
      "missing_node_ids", "duplicate_node_ids", "missing_names",
      "missing_genres (Song/Album only)", "missing_link_endpoints",
      "duplicate_links", "self_loops", "invalid_links", "orphan_nodes",
      "release_before_written", "notoriety_before_release"
    ),
    n = c(
      nrow(missing_node_ids), nrow(duplicate_node_ids), nrow(missing_names),
      nrow(missing_genres), nrow(missing_link_endpoints),
      nrow(duplicate_links), nrow(self_loops), nrow(invalid_links), nrow(orphan_nodes),
      nrow(release_before_written), nrow(notoriety_before_release)
    )
  )

  problem_tables <- list(
    missing_node_ids = missing_node_ids, duplicate_node_ids = duplicate_node_ids,
    missing_names = missing_names, missing_genres = missing_genres,
    missing_link_endpoints = missing_link_endpoints, duplicate_links = duplicate_links,
    self_loops = self_loops, invalid_links = invalid_links, orphan_nodes = orphan_nodes,
    release_before_written = release_before_written, notoriety_before_release = notoriety_before_release
  )

  return(list(problem_counts = problem_counts, problem_tables = problem_tables))
}
```

```{r}

core_preprocess <- function(file_path) {

  data <- fromJSON(file_path)
  nodes <- data$nodes
  links <- data$links

  colnames(nodes) <- colnames(nodes) %>% str_replace_all(" ", "_")
  colnames(links) <- colnames(links) %>% str_replace_all(" ", "_")

  loops_before <- nrow(links)
  links <- links %>% filter(source != target)
  removed_loops <- loops_before - nrow(links)

  nodes <- nodes %>%
    mutate(is_missing_stage_name = Node_Type %in% c("Person", "MusicalGroup") & is.na(stage_name))

  nodes$release_date <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(nodes$release_date))

  if ("name" %in% colnames(nodes)) nodes$name <- nodes$name %>% str_squish() %>% str_to_title()
  nodes$stage_name <- nodes$stage_name %>% str_squish() %>% str_to_title()

  nodes <- nodes %>%
    mutate(
      display_name = case_when(
        !is.na(stage_name) & !is_missing_stage_name ~ paste0(stage_name, " (", name, ")"),
        TRUE ~ coalesce(
          if_else(!is.na(stage_name) & stage_name != "", stage_name, NA_character_),
          name
        )
      )
    )

  if ("Node_Type" %in% colnames(nodes)) nodes$Node_Type <- nodes$Node_Type %>% str_squish()
  if ("Edge_Type" %in% colnames(links)) links$Edge_Type <- links$Edge_Type %>% str_squish()

  audit <- list(
    dropped_links = data.frame(
      reason = "self_loop",
      n = removed_loops
    )
  )

  return(list(nodes = nodes, links = links, audit = audit))
}
```

```{r}

build_aggregates <- function(nodes, links) {

  yearly_genre_event_counts <- nodes %>%
    filter(
      Node_Type %in% c("Song", "Album") &
        !is.na(release_date) &
        !is.na(genre) & genre != "Unknown"
    ) %>%
    count(year = release_date, genre, name = "n") %>%
    arrange(year, genre)

  return(list(yearly_genre_event_counts = yearly_genre_event_counts))
}
```

```{r}

build_network_metrics <- function(nodes, links) {

  genre_matrix <- links %>%
    filter(Edge_Type %in% influence_edges) %>%
    left_join(nodes %>% select(id, genre), by = c("source" = "id")) %>%
    rename(source_genre = genre) %>%
    left_join(nodes %>% select(id, genre), by = c("target" = "id")) %>%
    rename(target_genre = genre) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(source_genre) & !is.na(target_genre) &
        source_genre != "Unknown" & target_genre != "Unknown" &
        source_genre != target_genre
    ) %>%
    count(source_genre, target_genre, name = "n") %>%
    arrange(desc(n))

  return(list(genre_matrix = genre_matrix))
}
```

```{r}

oceanus_influence_over_time <- function(nodes, links) {

  oceanus_ids <- get_oceanus_ids(nodes)

  oceanus_influence_by_year <- links %>%
    filter(Edge_Type %in% influence_edges) %>%
    filter(target %in% oceanus_ids) %>%
    distinct(source, target, Edge_Type, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    left_join(
      nodes %>% select(id, display_name, genre, release_date, Node_Type),
      by = c("source" = "id")
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(release_date),
      genre != "Oceanus Folk",
      Node_Type %in% c("Song", "Album")
    ) %>%
    count(year = release_date, name = "influence_count") %>%
    arrange(year)

  return(oceanus_influence_by_year)
}
```

```{r}

artists_influenced_by_oceanus <- function(nodes, links) {

  creation_edge_types <- c("PerformerOf", "ComposerOf", "ProducerOf", "LyricistOf")

  oceanus_ids <- get_oceanus_ids(nodes)

  oceanus_influenced_works <- links %>%
    filter(Edge_Type %in% influence_edges) %>%
    filter(target %in% oceanus_ids) %>%
    distinct(source, target, Edge_Type, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    left_join(
      nodes %>% select(
        id,
        influenced_work_type = Node_Type,
        influenced_genre = genre,
        release_date
      ),
      by = c("source" = "id")
    ) %>%
    filter(
      influenced_work_type %in% c("Song", "Album"),
      !is.na(release_date),
      !is.na(influenced_genre),
      influenced_genre != "Oceanus Folk"
    )

  artist_links <- links %>%
    filter(Edge_Type %in% creation_edge_types) %>%
    distinct(source, target, Edge_Type, .keep_all = TRUE)

  influenced_artists <- oceanus_influenced_works %>%
    select(influenced_work_id = source, influenced_genre, release_date) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    inner_join(
      artist_links %>% select(artist_id = source, influenced_work_id = target, role = Edge_Type),
      by = "influenced_work_id"
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      nodes %>% select(artist_id = id, artist_name = display_name, artist_type = Node_Type),
      by = "artist_id"
    ) %>%
    filter(artist_type %in% c("Person", "MusicalGroup")) %>%
    group_by(artist_id, artist_name, artist_type) %>%
    summarise(
      influenced_works = n_distinct(influenced_work_id),
      influence_edges = n(),
      first_year = min(release_date, na.rm = TRUE),
      latest_year = max(release_date, na.rm = TRUE),
      genres = paste(sort(unique(influenced_genre)), collapse = ", "),
      roles = paste(sort(unique(role)), collapse = ", "),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(influenced_works), desc(influence_edges))

  return(influenced_artists)
}
```

```{r}

filter_genre_matrix <- function(genre_matrix) {

  flows <- genre_matrix %>%
    filter(source_genre == "Oceanus Folk" | target_genre == "Oceanus Folk") %>%
    mutate(
      from= target_genre,
      to= source_genre,
      value = n,
      type = case_when(
        from == "Oceanus Folk" ~ "Oceanus Folk influencing",
        to == "Oceanus Folk" ~ "Genres inspiring Oceanus Folk",
        TRUE ~ "Undisclosed"
      )
    ) %>%
    select(from, to, value, type) %>%
    arrange(type, desc(value))

  return(flows)
}
```

```{r}

inspiration_over_time <- function(nodes, links) {

  creation_edge_types <- c("PerformerOf", "ComposerOf", "ProducerOf", "LyricistOf")
  oceanus_ids <- get_oceanus_ids(nodes)

  inspiration_by_year <- links %>%
    filter(Edge_Type %in% influence_edges) %>%
    filter(source %in% oceanus_ids) %>%
    distinct(source, target, Edge_Type, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    left_join(
      nodes %>% select(id, oceanus_work_type = Node_Type, oceanus_release_year = release_date),
      by = c("source" = "id")
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      nodes %>% select(id, inspiring_work = name, inspiring_genre = genre),
      by = c("target" = "id")
    ) %>%
    filter(
      oceanus_work_type %in% c("Song", "Album"),
      !is.na(oceanus_release_year),
      !is.na(inspiring_genre),
      inspiring_genre != "Unknown",
      inspiring_genre != "Oceanus Folk"
    ) %>%
    inner_join(
      links %>%
        filter(Edge_Type %in% creation_edge_types) %>%
        select(artist_id = source, work_id = target, role = Edge_Type),
      by = c("target" = "work_id")
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      nodes %>% select(id, artist_name = display_name, artist_type = Node_Type),
      by = c("artist_id" = "id")
    ) %>%
    filter(artist_type %in% c("Person", "MusicalGroup")) %>%
    select(year = oceanus_release_year, inspiring_genre, inspiring_work, artist_name, artist_type, role) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    arrange(year, inspiring_genre, artist_name)

  return(inspiration_by_year)
}
```

```{r}

raw_inspection <- inspect_raw_data("data.json")
print(raw_inspection$problem_counts)

cleaned_data <- core_preprocess("data.json")
nodes <- cleaned_data$nodes
links <- cleaned_data$links
print(cleaned_data$audit$dropped_links)

aggregates <- build_aggregates(nodes, links)
network_metrics <- build_network_metrics(nodes, links)

oceanus_influence_by_year <- oceanus_influence_over_time(nodes, links)

artists_influenced <- artists_influenced_by_oceanus(nodes, links)
View(artists_influenced)
```

    arrange(desc(n)),
  "observable_data/q2b_genres_influenced_by_oceanus.json",

)

write_json(
  artists_influenced_by_oceanus(nodes, links),
  "observable_data/q2b_artists_influenced_by_oceanus.json",
  pretty = TRUE
)

# Q2c
write_json(
  filter_genre_matrix(network_metrics$genre_matrix),
  "observable_data/q2c_oceanus_flows.json",
  pretty = TRUE
)

write_json(
  inspiration_over_time(nodes, links),
  "observable_data/q2c_inspiration_over_time.json",
  pretty = TRUE
)

write_json(
  nodes %>%
    filter(Node_Type %in% c("Song", "Album"), genre == "Oceanus Folk", notable == TRUE, !is.na(notoriety_date)) %>%
    inner_join(
      links %>% filter(Edge_Type %in% c("PerformerOf", "ComposerOf", "ProducerOf", "LyricistOf")) %>%
        select(artist_id = source, work_id = target),
      by = c("id" = "work_id")
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      nodes %>% select(id, artist_name = name),
      by = c("artist_id" = "id")
    ) %>%
    count(year = notoriety_date, artist_name, name = "n") %>%
    arrange(year, artist_name),
  "observable_data/q2c_of_notoriety_by_year.json",
  pretty = TRUE
)
